review.notes: Full review. All 15 sampled targets and every Suggested.lean statement recomputed by hand and numerically (README Checks reproduced; bounds grid-tested). Sources: only DLMF readable (10 equations checked, one misquoted in the README: R02); Vilenkin-Klimyk, Klimyk-Vilenkin, Wawrzynczyk, Koornwinder paywalled and Heckman-Schlichtkrull not found, listed under Not verifiable. Cross-roadmap citations all resolved on main and at the open heads of SpecialFunctionsGroupModels and SpecialFunctionsSU11MatrixElements; local copies verbatim. Dependency check: 0 problems. Suggested.lean elaborates with sorry the only warning; one-tactic probe closes 3 of 6 tried. Findings: non-integrable complementary-series kernel in 3.4; false identity in the proof route of 0.2; Paley-Wiener and Carlson attributed to Mathlib but absent at the pin; hyperboloid model owned by RiemannianGeometry R4.7 and not cited; Paley-Wiener theorem of 1.3 and discrete-term inversion statable but absent from Suggested.lean. Two automatic-check leads set aside as false positives.
